content: Replace lines 658-660 inclusive, and separately lines 665-666, via line-based replace in current file. `self.options.private_members` is now either ALL (object) or list of strings; must handle both. For 658-660: original `keep = self.options.private_members` / `else: # keep documented attributes` / `keep = True`; new adds `if self.options.private_members is ALL:` then `keep = True` else `keep = membername in self.options.private_members`, preserving else. For 665-666: original `keep = self.options.private_members and \\` / `(has_doc or self.options.undoc_members)`; new wraps in `if ALL` → `keep = has_doc or self.options.undoc_members` else `keep = membername in self.options.private_members and (has_doc or self.options.undoc_members)`. Exact indentation must match; need to read current lines around those ranges first.
